release_notes: Prerelease from https://github.com/mwongj/VOD2MLIB/pull/2 (source PR remains open). Adds optional Emby duplicate prevention and cleanup, whole-show or missing-episode TV handling, selected libraries, failure policies, and optional immediate M3U-removal cleanup. Uses a persistent local SQLite ownership inventory, 1,000-record bulk transactions, bounded workers and process locking. STRMs are verified by raw URL equality; generated NFO hashes preserve metadata edits. Integration and M3U cleanup default off, deletion defaults to STRMs only. Includes conservative legacy adoption, cleanup preview/library discovery actions, scheduler settings and documentation. Preserves PR #1 native Dispatcharr category selection. Validation: 272 local tests passed with one Windows symlink test skipped; Python 3.10/3.12 Linux CI passed. Publisher tests and dry-run package/import checks passed. No live Emby smoke test or scale benchmark was performed.
